paite: Pilna in a-inn alam khin a, akhuam sagihte aphut hi.
heading: Pilna Leh Haina

paite: Agante agouta a; a-uain leng ahelta hi; adohkan leng abawl khinta hi.
Anungakte asawlkheta a, khopi mun sang penpente tung ah akikou a,
mimawl peuhmah, hiai lam ah hong kihei hen; theihsiamna nei lou amah tungtang ahihleh, ama'n akiang ah,
"Hong in, ka tanghou ne unla, ka helsa ka uain dawn un," achi hi.
Paikhia unla, nou mimawlte, hing un; theihsiamna lampi ah pai un.
Musitmi bawlhoih in amah a ding in zumhuaina amu; huan kuapeuh migilou-salou in amah a ding in minsiatna amu.
Musitmi sal dah in, nang ahon ho kha ding; mipil sal in, huchi in nang ahon it ding.
Mipil kiang ah hilhna pe lechin, apilzaw lai ding a; midiktat sinsak in.
TOUPA kihtak pilna bul ahi; misiangthou theihna theihsiamna ahi.
Kei ziak in na nite lah hihtam ahi ding a, na damsung kumte hihpun ahi ding hi.
Na pilleh, nangmah a dia pil na hi. Huan mi na muhsitleh, nang kia in na po ding hi.
Numei hai a-aphuai; mimawl ahi a, bangmah athei kei.
Huan a-inn kongkhak ah atu a, khopi mun sangte atutphah tung ah,
avialpaite sam ding, alampite ua pai zelte,
mimawl kuapeuh, hiai lai ah hong kihei hen; huan amah theihsiamna nei lou tungtang ahihleh, ama'n akiang ah,
tuigukte akhum a, aguk a tanghou nek anuam, achi hi.
Himahleh ama'n huai ah misite a-om uh chih leh amichialte Sheol thuk ah a-om uh chih athei kei hi.
